decisions.reason: As an organic ham very close to our core cured-meat know-how and stated organic expansion path, it fits knowledge we already possess, so we are likely to retain and refine it despite no clear R&D signal.
This organic sliced Kasseler is closely related to our established smoked and cured pork capabilities, which makes learning and incremental improvement feasible and supports keeping it in the range.
An organic pepper salami sits squarely within our seasoning and salami expertise, so absorptive capacity is high and the product is more likely to be kept than discontinued.

Although the teriyaki aspic variant is more niche and somewhat less traditional, it still builds on our aspic and deli-counter competence, so we would more likely keep it while monitoring demand closely.
A fennel-flavoured sliced salami is a manageable flavour extension of an existing product family, and its dedicated presentation suggests enough strategic interest to keep it on the market.
This liver pâté with veal is a premium line extension well within our pâté and cooked-meat knowledge base, so we would generally keep it unless sales proved clearly disappointing.
